ladder.purpose: Decide whether the use case merits a paid Diagnostic.
Assess data, economics and experiment feasibility.
Run one controlled policy comparison when readiness gates pass.
Optional periodic decision support after verified pilot evidence.

success_definition.diagnostic: Required data assessed, feasibility determined, draft contract and recommendation delivered; positive uplift is not required.
success_definition.pilot: Experiment integrity assessed, outcomes and economics evaluated, Evidence Package delivered and a valid decision produced; positive profit is not required.

claim_boundaries: Historical or diagnostic analysis is descriptive/shadow unless canonical experiment gates pass.
No customer results, logos or testimonials are included in these artifacts.
